QUOTE: "`NavigationHeader` (`app/components/navigation_header/index.tsx`) does not use the ref itself. It forwards it to `NavigationSearch` only when `hasSearch` is true."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that NavigationHeader forwards the ref to NavigationSearch, and that this happens only when `hasSearch` is true. It also says the search input is only mounted when `hasSearch` is true. It never says outright that the ref is attached to nothing otherwise, but that follows directly from those two statements.
